summary: AgentNDX accepted a public review submission for Synapse Network MCP. MCP Central exposes the official SynapseNetworkAI server in sitemap, but the detail page is Cloudflare-gated/missing tool terms from the CLI fetch. mcp.so has a guessed slug that returns Project not found. PulseMCP, MCP Central, and MseeP have mixed crawler/form boundaries that should not be counted as answer-engine visibility yet.

submit_page.review_policy_text_observed: AgentNDX is curated — no self-serve publishing. Submit your server for review. We'll evaluate within 48 hours.

post_submit_public_search.api_services_check_result: The public API query did not return parseable JSON during this run; the listing is treated as review-pending, not live.

agentndx.completion_gate: Only count AgentNDX as live source-host evidence after search/API or a public /server URL includes Synapse Network, SynapseNetworkAI, Remote MCP URL, and tool names.

mcpcentral.detail_fetch_status: HTTP/2 403 Cloudflare challenge observed in curl fetch; record_ai_visibility_source_host_execution saw only identifier terms, not full listing terms.

mcp_so.submit_page_status: HTTP/2 200; contains submit form copy but also sign-in surface. No automated submission was performed in this run.

pulsemcp.servers_page_status: HTTP/2 200; no Synapse required terms found in fetched page.
pulsemcp.submit_status: HTTP/2 403 Cloudflare attention page in CLI fetch.
pulsemcp.robots_boundary: robots.txt allows general search but disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, and several AI/training bots; do not prioritize as AI-answer source-host until a listing is live and accessible.

mseep.observed_policy: For open source projects, make the MCP server public on GitHub with an open source license and include MCP Server or mcp-server in README; MseeP says it will automatically discover and scan it. Commercial/private listings require contact form.

decision.new_successful_feed_action: AgentNDX review submission accepted via 302 success redirect and success page.
decision.new_partial_live_surface: MCP Central sitemap contains official SynapseNetworkAI server URL but detail fetch is not yet adequate evidence.
next_actions: Recheck AgentNDX in 48 hours for public /server listing or API result.
Use a browser session or downstream public cache to validate MCP Central detail page after Cloudflare challenge clears.
